briefs.text: Russian drones kill 3; strike on Kharkiv university kills a woman.
Ukrainian drones hit a refinery, a plant and an airfield.
EU split over €45bn Ukraine loan; Russian import ban eyed.
Sweden summons Russia's envoy; quits EU budget talks.
London hit by 24-hour Tube strike; Portsmouth bomb probe.
Gérard Depardieu to face trial on sexual assault charge.
Georgia: Russia plans to absorb its occupied regions.
Judges urge dropping Netanyahu charges; Oct 7 inquiry on.
Israeli strikes hit south Lebanon; drones over Beirut.
Israeli strikes kill 10 in Gaza despite the ceasefire.
Iraq seals Iran crossing; jails eight French IS members.
Japan plans $353bn defence; warns off Chinese ships.
Vietnam in advanced trade talks with the US.
China's industrial profits grow faster; recovery uneven.
Myanmar rejects full compliance with ICJ orders.
Hong Kong on alert as city marks fire that killed 168.
Kenya court halts Ebola centre; Congo cases pass 12,000.
Kenyan cult leader convicted of terrorism charges.
Cairo fuel-truck crash and fire kill at least 31.
DR Congo queries Ugandan general; Zambia probes coup plot.
Argentina bans central bank from printing money.
JPMorgan: AI puts 24 million jobs at risk in five years.
Trump defends Nvidia chief Huang; invites Putin to G20.
Musk pledges two SpaceX shares for every US child.
Trump lashes foes in Thanksgiving message; Florida aid OK'd.
North Korea pauses some arms deliveries to Russia.
US approves $622m deal to keep Ukraine's F-16s flying.

footer_note: Every story on this page was reported on Friday 27 November 2026 (UTC).

headlines.body: A powerful nor'easter knocked out power to nearly a million homes and businesses, cancelled more than 400 flights and forced New York to postpone the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade for the first time in its 100-year history. The parade moves to Saturday.
headlines.title: A million in the dark as Thanksgiving storm batters the US East Coast

headlines.body: Ukraine's president said Russia is preparing another mass attack on the power grid as winter nears. Donald Trump said he pressed Vladimir Putin, in talks in China, to end all military aggression in Europe.
headlines.title: Zelenskyy warns of a new mass strike as Trump tells Putin to "pull back"

headlines.body: A projectile hit Aramco's Jazan refinery, killing a Nepali worker and halting some operations. The coalition said it destroyed the Houthi launcher in Hodeidah. In Kuwait, two Italian technicians died in a drone attack Iran denies.
headlines.title: Houthi strike on Saudi refinery kills one; Kuwait drone attack kills two Italians

headlines.body: Final results from the 7 November election gave Christopher Luxon's National-led coalition 65 of 130 seats, one short of a majority. He now needs the centrist Opportunity Party, which won seven seats in its first election, to stay in power.
headlines.title: New Zealand left with a hung parliament as coalition falls one seat short

headlines.body: Rescuers recovered more bodies on Thursday from a flooded illegal gold mine in Bogor, West Java, taking the death toll to 13. Thirteen remain trapped in shafts about 100 metres deep; eleven men escaped.
headlines.title: Indonesia mine flood toll rises to 13, with 13 still missing

headlines.body: Russian missiles struck Kyiv overnight, wounding seven and hitting a shopping centre. Ukraine said its "Blysk" laser shot down a jet-powered Shahed drone, a first in combat. Kyiv's drones hit a refinery, oil tanks and an airfield.
headlines.title: Kyiv hit by ballistic missiles; Ukraine claims first laser kill of a drone

sources: Reuters, Associated Press, Al Jazeera, Gulf News, Channel News Asia, The Economic Times
